description: This file implements the mayfly task scheduling mechanism for the Zephyr RTOS Bluetooth controller, including initialization, enabling/disabling, enqueuing, running, and unit testing of mayfly tasks.

methods.name: mayfly_init
methods.description: Initializes the mayfly queues for all callee and caller pairs.

methods.name: mayfly_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables mayfly tasks between specified caller and callee IDs.

methods.name: mayfly_enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a mayfly task for execution, possibly inline or deferred.

methods.name: mayfly_run
methods.description: Executes pending mayfly tasks for a specific callee ID.
